newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends little changed in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends little changed in light trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar finished a light trading session on Monday marginally softer against the U.S. dollar.
At the close, the Taiwan dollar was quoted at T$27.487 per U.S. unit, virtually unchanged from Saturday's T$27.486 finish.
Turnover was a light US$117 million.
Dealers were reluctant to take positions because customer business was very light, a foreign bank dealer said.
"The national holiday may be keeping some customers out of the market," he said.
Thursday is Taiwan's "Double Tenth" holiday observing the founding of the Republic of China.
The Taiwan dollar dipped near the close after trading slightly firmer against the U.S. unit for most of the day.

"The U.S. dollar is hitting resistance against the yen and the mark that supported the Taiwan dollar," said another dealer, adding that the greenback's correction after a recent rally should continue buoying the local unit in the near term.
